Grandma’s Lentil Stew

By Ruth Adler

A thick, cheap, filling stew.

55 minutes Serves 6 bowls
  • 1 1/2 cups brown lentils
  • 2 carrots, diced
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 6 cups water
  1. Sweat the onion and carrots in oil.
  2. Add lentils and water; simmer 45 minutes.
  3. Season and serve with bread.
Soup, Jewish
